title: Sea-King's Blessing — Dominion of the Deep
revision: Draft 3 / Sea-King's Blessing classification / forked tree

classification.applies_to: existing supported tags of every Sea-King's Blessing jutsu

emphasis.primary: Increase Damage Taken — Crushing Abyss's broad circle exposure and Water Dome's Water-only exposure (two rows, +7 ceiling)
emphasis.secondary: Water damage — Sea King's Armor and Crushing Abyss (two formula rows at 38, +6 ceiling)
emphasis.tertiary: Decrease Damage Taken — Sea King's Armor's self reduction (one row, +10 ceiling)
emphasis.rationale: Sea-King's Blessing is a rank-C kit whose five supported rows split 2/2/1: two 38-power Water hits (Sea King's Armor, Crushing Abyss; both 60 AP, cooldown 7), two enemy Increase Damage Taken rows (Abyss 30% on enemies in its circle, all four stat types and no element; Water Dome 35% Water-only on a 40 AP, cooldown-6 cast) and one 30% self Decrease Damage Taken row on Armor. Exposure is primary because it is the kit's most distinctive and most frequent effect and, for the two rounds after each cast, adds to every non-pierce hit the target takes (Abyss) or every Water hit (Dome), allies' included; the kit's own hits are modest. Raw Water power is secondary: it is the kit's direct output and the bloodline's Water IDG passive multiplies it. Armor's reduction is tertiary: one row, two rounds in seven. Absorb and shield rows are unsupported.

nodes.name: Scales of the Deep
nodes.flavor: The sea-king's gift settles on the skin first: salt-hard scale, and a heavier fist.
nodes.coverage_note: Armor and Abyss hits 38→39 power; Armor's self Decrease Damage Taken 30→32% (2 rounds, all four stat types, no element). 3 of 5 rows.

nodes.name: Grip of the Riptide
nodes.flavor: What the riptide takes, it takes whole. There is no half-drowning.
nodes.coverage_note: Both Water hits: Sea King's Armor and Crushing Abyss 38→41 power with Scales of the Deep; 60 AP, cooldown 7, range 4 each.

nodes.name: Weight of the Trench
nodes.flavor: Miles of black water press down at once, and nothing built by hands keeps its shape.
nodes.coverage_note: Route total +6: Armor and Abyss 38→44 power at jutsu level 25; two formula hits, the bloodline's Water IDG passive multiplies on top.

nodes.name: Deepwater Carapace
nodes.flavor: Pressure that would crush a hull only sets the sea-king's armor tighter.
nodes.coverage_note: Armor's Decrease Damage Taken 30→35% with Scales of the Deep (self, 2 rounds per 60 AP cast, cooldown 7). 1 row; pierce bypasses it.

nodes.name: Hull of the Leviathan
nodes.flavor: No storm has ever opened the leviathan. The sea-king wears its hide and dares the storm.
nodes.coverage_note: Route total +10: Armor's reduction 30→40% for its 2 rounds; +1 power on Armor and Abyss (40 with Scales of the Deep). 3 rows.

nodes.name: Salt in the Wound
nodes.flavor: Brine finds every cut. After the sea-king marks you, so does everything else.
nodes.coverage_note: Abyss exposure 30→32% (enemies in the circle, all stat types, no element); Dome exposure 35→37% (Water hits only). 2 rows.

nodes.name: Dragged Under
nodes.flavor: Once the current has your ankle, every blow lands on someone who cannot stand.
nodes.coverage_note: Abyss exposure 30→34%, Dome exposure 35→39% with Salt in the Wound (enemy debuffs, 2 rounds; Dome is 40 AP, cooldown 6). 2 rows.

nodes.name: Wrath of the Sea-King
nodes.flavor: The deep has a king, and the king has run out of mercy.
nodes.coverage_note: Route total +7: Abyss exposure 37%, Dome 42% (2 rounds each; they add on Water hits while both are up); +1 power on both Water hits.

examples.name: Weight of the Trench
examples.rationale: +6 raw Water power: Armor and Abyss 38→44 at jutsu level 25, before the bloodline's Water IDG passive (15 + 0.15/level) multiplies. Salt in the Wound is the fourth purchase: Dome 37% / Abyss 32% exposure for the two rounds after each cast, so an earlier Dome or Abyss lifts the next hits (a strike never benefits from its own cast's row); Deepwater Carapace (Armor reduction 35%) is the self-side alternative.

examples.name: Hull of the Leviathan
examples.rationale: Armor's Decrease Damage Taken 30→40% for its two rounds against every non-pierce hit, with +2 power on both hits (40/40) from the Foundation and the capstone. Salt in the Wound adds 32%/37% exposure so the fortress still sets up damage for the team; Grip of the Riptide (hits 42/42) is the pure-offense fourth purchase.

examples.name: Wrath of the Sea-King
examples.rationale: +7 on both exposure rows: Abyss 37% (all stat types, enemies in the circle), Dome 42% (Water hits only, 40 AP, cooldown 6); they add on Water hits while both are up, which for the caster means Armor's hit (Abyss's own row never covers Abyss's hit, and its cooldown 7 outlasts the 2-round window). Scales of the Deep is the only legal fourth purchase and adds +1 power (hits 40/40 with the capstone's +1) and Armor reduction 32%.

narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on five rows (Damage x2, Increase Damage Taken x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1), so it supports exactly three routes: Scales of the Deep forks into a Water damage route (Grip of the Riptide → Weight of the Trench, +6 at the Damage guardrail) and an Armor route (Deepwater Carapace → Hull of the Leviathan, +10 on the single reduction row); Salt in the Wound → Dragged Under → Wrath of the Sea-King is a single chain on the kit's two enemy debuffs (+7, the two-row ceiling). A fourth route needs a fourth tag the kit does not have (absorb and shield are not potency targets). Universal node accepted: Scales of the Deep is in all 8 legal full builds, because no 1 BP leaf Hidden Art under Salt in the Wound has a distinct role. Any IDT on the leaf lifts 06,07,08,leaf above the +7 ceiling; without IDT, the leaf must carry Damage +2 or more or DDT +3 or more for 06,07,08,leaf to escape domination by 01,06,07,08 (Damage +2, IDT +7, DDT +2), and either one makes 01,04,06,leaf or 01,02,06,leaf equal or dominate 01,02,04,06 (Damage +3, IDT +2, DDT +5) (all leaf flats up to Damage +4, IDT +4, DDT +5 enumerated; none passes). A mirrored layout would only move the universal node to the other root. So the exposure route's fourth purchase is always Scales of the Deep, while Burst and Bulwark each have two. Three named capstone builds exist, one per Advanced Art; eight legal full allocations in total (five with a capstone, three hybrids).
design_notes: Node split: 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Scales of the Deep (Damage +1 on both hits, Decrease Damage Taken +2 on Armor; 3 of 5 rows) is the self-side root and forks into Grip of the Riptide → Weight of the Trench (Damage +2/+3) and Deepwater Carapace → Hull of the Leviathan (DDT +3/+5 with Damage +1). Salt in the Wound → Dragged Under → Wrath of the Sea-King (IDT +2/+2/+3 with Damage +1) is the enemy-side chain. Every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; any two cost 5 or 6 BP.

Reference reuse: Grip of the Riptide → Weight of the Trench copies Taiyo Kami's Crown of Cinders → Solar Cataclysm (+2/+3 Damage), and the Armor route copies its DDT line (2+3+5 = +10; 30→40%) nearly verbatim; one DDT row fits that shape. Departures: Scales of the Deep's Damage +1 makes the two-row Damage route +6 (38→44, the guardrail; Taiyo +5 on three rows); IDT runs 2+2+3 to the two-row ceiling +7 (30→37%, 35→42%); no IDG rows, so both capstone secondaries are Damage +1, below Grip's +2.

Interactions: Armor's DDT row and Abyss's IDT row list all four stat types with no element, so they match every non-pierce hit of any element (Highest resolves to one of the four). Dome's IDT row carries Water and no stat filter: Water damage only (the caster's two hits, allies' Water jutsu), not basic attacks, weapons or plain jutsu. IDT rows add power/100 × the staged base per hit and stack additively; the bloodline's Water IDG passive (15 + 0.15/level) multiplies the two Water hits on top.

Delivery: all three jutsu are OTHER_USER at range 4; 2-round rows are live the two rounds after the cast round. Armor (60 AP, cooldown 7, SINGLE) hits for Water and gives the caster DDT 30% and an unsupported 100 shield (SELF rows). Abyss (60 AP, cooldown 7, radius-1 AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN) hits and exposes enemies in the circle 30% (friendly fire ENEMIES; never the caster). Dome (40 AP, cooldown 6, SINGLE) exposes the target 35%. Aimed at an ally, ENEMIES rows are withheld; SELF rows still land.

Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) finishes with Salt in the Wound (exposure 32/37%) or Deepwater Carapace (Armor 35%); Bulwark (01,04,05) with Salt in the Wound or Grip of the Riptide (hits 42/42); Exposure (01,06,07,08) only with Scales of the Deep. No-capstone hybrids: 01,02,04,06 (41/41, 35%, 32/37%), 01,02,06,07 (41/41, 32%, 34/39%) and 01,04,06,07 (39/39, 35%, 34/39%); 01,02,03,04 and 01,02,04,05 stay inside the first root. 8 legal full allocations, all non-dominated, every node used.

Row-weighted value: 01,06,07,08 is the strongest full allocation at 20 (IDT +7 on two rows, Damage +2 on two, DDT +2 on one), against Taiyo Kami's 31 on nine rows and Shinseina Ki's 26 on six; per supported row (4.0) it sits between them. Lowest-value purchases by row weight are Deepwater Carapace (+3 on one row) and Salt in the Wound (+2 on two rows); Carapace's value is defensive uptime on a 60 AP cast, Salt's is downstream on hits the exposed enemy takes (any under Abyss, Water under Dome).
risks: Classification: Water is a basic element carried by 23 census bloodlines (Shinrai Ou, Tetsugan, Shiroi Youso, Teno Yuki and other INCLUDE kits among them) and whether NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN jutsu carry it is unverified. The tree assumes the bloodline-keyed classification extension; a bare Water element match would leak every node to other Water rows and vice versa.

Resolver: 2 of 5 supported rows (Armor's DDT, Abyss's IDT) have no element and fall back to None under the current resolver, so affectedElements=['Water'] cannot reach them; reaching them through None would also reach every element-less row on any jutsu the player casts. The three Water rows match directly.

Exposure breadth (user-owned value): with Wrath of the Sea-King, Abyss 37% + Dome 42% = 79 points of IDT (65 at base) while both are up, on Water hits only: the caster's Armor hit and allies' Water jutsu (Abyss's hit gets Dome's 42% at most). Other hits get Abyss's 37% alone. Same-tag effects all apply and add (§3b). Trim the capstone to +2 (route +6) if double exposure proves too strong.

Universal opener (accepted; narrow_kit_exception has the leaf enumeration): an Exposure player always buys Scales of the Deep's Damage +1 and DDT +2, wanted or not. Shinseina Ki, Lycanthropy, Reptilian and Loup-Garou share this shape. Any leaf that relieves it costs the +7 IDT ceiling or adds a twin or dominated build; accepting one is user-owned.

DDT breadth: Armor's reduction lists all four stat types with no element, so +10 makes it 40% against effectively every non-pierce hit for the two rounds after each cast (two in seven); pierce bypasses it. The bloodline's Earth IDT 10% passive multiplies Earth hits with or without the buff, so the Earth weakness stays. Armor's 100 shield and Dome's absorb are unsupported and unchanged.

Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling) and then multiplied by the bloodline's Water IDG passive, while any exposure on the target adds its percentage of the staged base, so +6 raw power is not linear +6 damage; realized value depends on stats and enemy state. Rank C kit with two 60 AP hits on cooldown 7; no combat simulation was performed.

Dome's Water-filtered exposure: the row lists Water with no stat filter, so under getEfficiencyRatio (SOURCE_MECHANICS.md §3) its tag list is [Water]: it matches Water damage only, since an element-list row reaches element-less hits only when its list includes None. Basic attacks, weapons and non-Water jutsu are unaffected by Dome's 42%; only Abyss's row (four stat types, no element) is broad.
Ranked modes: skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin, so no node applies there.

audit.revision: Draft 3 / Sea-King's Blessing classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.
All existing supported tags of Sea-King's Blessing jutsu inherit Sea-King's Blessing potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.
Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.
